Date March 10, 1938 // 3 38
Subject Suicide of A.I. Scherbakoff, Soviet Citizen.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Clauson D.J

The inquest held in the Public Mortuary, Miaochow
Road, on 7-3-38 regarding the death of Mr. A.I. Scherbakoff,
Soviet citizen, was attended by the undersigned. Nothing was
revealed during the proceedings to which a political significance
could be attached.

The Russian pro-Soviet newspaper "Novosti Dnia" in
the issue dated 7-3-38 mentioned home-sickness as the likely
reason of Scherbakoff's suicide, but after the inquest abandoned
this theory.

Afanasy Ivanovich Scherbakoff resided in Shanghai
since 1920 or 1921 . It is reported that he obtained a Soviet
passport in 1924, when the Soviet Consulate-General was established
in this city. He was known to this office as an associate of
Soviet employees and agents and at one time was suspected of being
a secret Soviet agent.

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

事由：苏联公民 A.I. Scherbakoff 自杀案。
由 D.S.I. Prokofiev 撰写。经 C. Clauson D.J 转呈

签署人出席了于1938年3月7日在庙路（Miaochow Road）公立殓房举行的关于苏联公民 A.I. Scherbakoff 先生死亡案件的验尸听证会。听证过程中未披露任何具有政治意义的内容。

亲苏俄文报纸《今日新闻》（Novosti Dnia）在1938年3月7日刊中提及，思乡病可能是 Scherbakoff 自杀的可能原因，但在验尸后放弃了这一理论。

Afanasy Ivanovich Scherbakoff 自1920年或1921年起居住在上海。据报，他于1924年苏联驻本市总领事馆成立时获得了苏联护照。本处知悉其为苏联雇员及代理人的关联人员，并曾一度被怀疑为苏联秘密特工。

A. Prokofiev
副督察长 (D. S. I.)

归档
J.B.Q.
3月11日。

D. C. （特务科）

Suicide of U.S.S.R. Citizen Mr. A. Scherbakoff.

Sir,

An inquest regarding the death of Mr. A. Scherbakoff was held in the Public Mortuary, Kiachow Road, on the morning of 7/3/38, Procurator Soong Kung San presiding; Mr. M.A. Constantinov U.S.S.R. Vice Consul, attended, and Dri Prokofiev was also present.

At the conclusion of the proceedings the following verdict was handed down:-

"Death due to gunshot wound. Body to be removed by Mr. M.A. Constantinov. Pistol to be handed to police for disposal."

The procurator did not order the sealed letters and parcels left by deceased to be opened, giving it as his opinion that this and disposal of deceased's other property should be dealt with by the U.S.S.R. Consulate.

After the inquest, Mr. Constantinov opened the letter addressed to the U.S.S.R. Consulate. Same merely contained a request for the disposal of his body and the liquidation of his business, etc. no reason for the suicide being given. A cheque for $1,000.00, the keys of deceased's office at 233 Nanking Road, and deceased's passport, were enclosed.

先生：

关于 A. Scherbakoff 先生死亡案的验尸听证会于1938年3月7日上午在胶州路（Kiachow Road）公立殓房举行，由检察官宋公三（Soong Kung San，音译）主持；苏联副领事 M.A. Constantinov 先生出席，Prokofiev 副督察长亦在场。

程序结束时，作出如下裁决：

“死因为枪伤。尸体由 M.A. Constantinov 先生领回。手枪移交警方处理。”

检察官未下令开启死者留下的密封信件和包裹，他认为此事及死者其他财产的处理应由苏联领事馆负责。

验尸后，Constantinov 先生拆开了致苏联领事馆的信件。信中仅请求处理其身后事及清算其业务等，未说明自杀原因。信中附有一张1,000.00美元的支票、死者位于南京路233号办公室的钥匙以及死者的护照。

Suicide of U.S.S.R. Citizen, Mr. A. Scherbakoff,
in Foreign Y.M.C.A. Bubbling Well Road.

Sir,
    At 10.10a.m. on 6-3-38, a telephone-message was
received at this Station from the Foreign Y.M.C.A.
Bubbling Well Road, to the effect that a foreign resident,
Mr. A. Scherbakoff, had committed suicide in Room 530 of
the above institution.
    S.I. Duncan, C.D.C. 131 and the undersigned proceeded
to the scene, and were shown to Room 530 by Mr. W.G.
Schmidt, Assistant Secretary.
    On a bed in the room, the dead body of a male foreigner,
dressed in pyjamas, was lying face upwards in a pool of
congealed blood, which had exuded from a gunshot wound at
the top of the skull. Both hands were lying across the
abdomen and were covered by a mirror which had been
detached from a chest of drawers in the room. In the
right hand, the deceased grasped a "Webley & Scott .32
automatic pistol, maker's No. 98078, (unlicensed) in new
condition.' There was one round in the breech and six
in the magazine. One spent cartridge case, and one bullet,
badly distorted through having struck the wall above the
head of the deceased, were found lying among the bedclothes.
    In a wardrobe in the room, the following articles were
found.

苏联公民 A. Scherbakoff 先生在静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）外国青年会自杀案。

先生：
    1938年3月6日上午10点10分，本巡捕房接到静安寺路外国青年会的电话消息，称一名外籍居民 A. Scherbakoff 先生在该机构530室自杀。
    副督察 Duncan、刑事侦缉队长 131号及签署人随即赶赴现场，由助理秘书 W.G. Schmidt 先生引导至530室。
    室内床上躺着一名身穿睡衣的外籍男子尸体，面部朝上，躺在从头顶枪伤渗出并已凝固的血泊中。双手交叉放在腹部，上面覆盖着一面从室内五斗橱上取下的镜子。死者右手紧握一把“韦伯利-斯科特 .32口径自动手枪”，制造商编号98078，（无执照），成色全新。枪膛内有一发子弹，弹匣内有六发。在床单中发现一枚已击发的弹壳和一颗因击中死者头部上方墙壁而严重变形的子弹。
    在室内的衣柜中发现了以下物品。

(1) One box containing 49 rounds of .32 "Colt"
ammunition.
(2) One box containing 25 rounds of .32 ammunition.
Belgian make.
(3) One pistol holster.
(4) Four empty packets which had contained Bayer's
"Veronal" tablets, and a receipt for same,
price $3.80, issued by the Anglo-Chinese Dis-
pensary, Foochow Road, to Mr. Scherbakoff, 207
Hardoon Building, dated 1st March, 1938.
(5) One Y.M.C.A. teacup, with a white powdery substance
believed to be veronal, adhering to the sides.

Found lying on the top of a chest of drawers in the
room was an unsealed envelope bearing the inscription
in English:- "To all my friends. Last few words". The
envelope contained a sheet of business writing paper with
the heading "A. Scherbakoff, Woollen Piece Goods, 233
Nanking Road, Room 207", on which the following message
was written.

"To all my friends last few words.
I am taking my life because I noticed that
I am on the decline and because I don't want
to be a witness of my own slow fading and
destruction.
In other words, discontinuance of my being
I consider as avoidance of unpleasant process.
Anyhow I thank my fate for joys and sorrows.
Good luck everybody.
(Signed) A. Scherbakoff".

Also found on the top of the chest of drawers were
the following:-

(1) One sealed letter addressed to "Mr. L. Kozloff,
61 Nanking Road, Local".
(2) One sealed letter and parcel addressed to Mr.
S.G. Vasin, Room 539, Hardoon Building.
(3) One sealed letter and parcel addressed to
"General Consulate U.S.S.R. in Shanghai,
Temporary Office, 44 Route Grouchy".
(4) One sealed letter and parcel addressed to
"Tang Ting Wang, 36 Caynon Road, Local".

1（第2页）

(1) 一盒装有49发 .32口径“柯尔特”弹药。
(2) 一盒装有25发 .32口径弹药。比利时制造。
(3) 一个手枪皮套。
(4) 四个曾装有拜耳公司“维罗那”（Veronal，即巴比妥）药片的空包装袋，以及一张收据，金额3.80美元，由福州路英华大药房开具给 Scherbakoff 先生（地址：哈同大楼207室），日期为1938年3月1日。
(5) 一个青年会茶杯，杯壁附着白色粉末状物质，推测为维罗那。

在室内五斗橱顶部发现一个未封口的信封，上有英文字样：“致我所有的朋友。最后几句话”。信封内装有一张商业信纸，抬头为“A. Scherbakoff，毛呢匹头商，南京路233号，207室”，上面写有以下留言。

“致我所有的朋友最后几句话。
我结束自己的生命是因为我注意到
我的身体正在衰退，而且我不愿
目睹自己缓慢的衰落和毁灭。
换句话说，我将停止存在视为
避免痛苦过程的一种方式。
无论如何，我感谢命运给予我的欢乐与悲伤。
祝大家好运。
（签名）A. Scherbakoff”。

在五斗橱顶部还发现了以下物品：

(1) 一封致“本地南京路61号 L. Kozloff 先生”的密封信件。
(2) 一封致哈同大楼539室 S.G. Vasin 先生的密封信件及包裹。
(3) 一封致“上海苏联总领事馆，临时办公处，古鲁西路（Route Grouchy）44号”的密封信件及包裹。
(4) 一封致“本地康脑脱路（Caynon Road）36号 Tang Ting Wang”的密封信件及包裹。

(5) One book entitled "I photograph Russia" containing
a note "This book belongs to the resident of Room
430".

In addition to the above, a sealed letter addressed
to Mr. W.E. Hines, Business Secretary of the Foreign
Y.M.C.A., left on the chest of drawers, was removed
before the arrival of Police by Mr. Schmidt and handed
to Mr. Hines.

From enquiries made, it was ascertained that the
deceased was a U.S.S.R. citizen named A. Scherbakoff, age
about 48, woollen piece goods merchant with business
premises at Room 207, Nos. 233 Nanking Road. Since
February 1936 he has resided in Room 530 of the Foreign
Y.M.C.A. Bubbling Well Road. He was last seen alive at
about 9.30p.m. on 5-3-38, by a room boy named Lee Tu
rwan (李杜官), who took him a cup of tea to his room.
At 9.50a.m. on 6-3-38, a room boy named Ling Kwaung Kwei
(林廣閏) went to the room to call deceased, and receiving
no answer, opened the locked door with his key. He
observed the unnatural appearance of deceased, and
immediately reported to Mr. Schmidt, who proceeded to the
room and made an examination. As reported above, Mr.
Schmidt removed the letter addressed to Mr. Hines, and
the latter reported the matter to this Station by
telephone.

From the evidence available, it would appear that the
deceased first consumed the contents of the veronal packet

1（第3页）

(5) 一本名为《我拍摄俄罗斯》（I photograph Russia）的书，内含一张纸条，注明“本书属于430室住户”。

除上述物品外，一封致外国青年会商务秘书 W.E. Hines 先生的密封信件原本留在五斗橱上，但在警方到达前已被 Schmidt 先生取下并交给 Hines 先生。

经查询查明，死者名为 A. Scherbakoff，苏联公民，年龄约48岁，毛呢匹头商，营业地点位于南京路233号207室。自1936年2月以来，他一直居住在静安寺路外国青年会530室。最后一次被人看见活着是在1938年3月5日晚上9点30分左右，由一名名叫李杜官（Lee Tu rwan）的茶房侍者看到，当时该侍者给他送茶进房间。1938年3月6日上午9点50分，一名名叫林廣閏（Ling Kwaung Kwei）的茶房侍者去房间叫醒死者，因无人应答，便用钥匙打开了锁着的门。他观察到死者状态异常，立即向 Schmidt 先生报告，Schmidt 先生随即前往房间进行检查。如上所述，Schmidt 先生取走了致 Hines 先生的信件，后者通过电话向本巡捕房报告了此事。

根据现有证据，死者似乎先服用了维罗那包装袋内的内容物

page_data.en:
1 (Sheet 4)

mixed with liquid in the teacup, then lay down in bed
and shot himself with the pistol, placing the muzzle
of the weapon in his mouth. He apparently used the
mirror to assist him in this action. The exact time at
which he committed suicide has not been established as
no person in the building could remember hearing the sound
of a shot.

Mr. S.G. Vasian, who resides in Room 529 of the
Y.M.C.A. and who is a friend of the deceased, was inter-
viewed. He stated that he has known the deceased for the
past fifteen years, and formerly lived together with him
at No. 17 Rue Paul Henry, French Concession. As far as
he knew, the deceased came to Shanghai about 1921, and
was previously a partner in the business of Mr. L. Kosloff,
61 Nanking Road, but left there and started his own busi-
ness about three years ago. For the past week the
deceased complained of a severe cold, but was not confined
to his room. The last occasion on which he was seen by
Mr. Vasian was about 7p.m. on 5-3-38, when they met in
the corridor outside deceased's room. The deceased then
complained that he did not feel well, but gave no indica-
tion that he intended to take his life. Mr. Vasian was
unable to advance any reason for the deceased wishing to
end his life, as he believed him to be in comfortable
circumstances and without any worries.

In the letter written to Mr. Hines, the deceased stated
page_data.zh:
1（第4页）

将其与茶杯中的液体混合服用，然后躺在床上，用手枪对准口腔开枪自杀。他显然利用镜子来辅助这一动作。确切的自杀时间尚未确定，因为大楼内没有人记得听到枪声。

采访了住在青年会529室且为死者朋友的 S.G. Vasian 先生。他表示认识死者已有十五年，以前曾与他共同居住在法租界亨利路（Rue Paul Henry）17号。据他所知，死者约于1921年来到上海，此前曾是南京路61号 L. Kosloff 先生生意的合伙人，但约在三年前离开那里开始自营生意。在过去的一周里，死者抱怨患重感冒，但并未卧床不起。Vasian 先生最后一次见到死者是在1938年3月5日晚上7点左右，当时他们在死者房外的走廊相遇。死者当时抱怨身体不适，但未流露出任何自杀意图。Vasian 先生无法提出死者希望结束生命的任何理由，因为他认为死者生活宽裕，没有任何烦恼。

在致 Hines 先生的信中，死者陈述

page_data.en:
1 (Sheet 5)

that he had enclosed in his letter to the U.S.S.R.
Consulate, a cheque on the Hongkong and Shanghai Bank,
No. H24317 for $1,000.00, for the purpose of having his
body cremated, and also requested them to dispose of his
goods and liquidate his business at 233 Nanking Road.
Enclosed in Mr. Hines's letter were the undermentioned
cheques and money with the following requests:-
(1) One cheque No. 124319 for $150.00, for deceased's
office boy, Hung Ting Waung, 26 Seymour Road.
(2) One cheque No. 124320 for $30.00 and $70.00 in
notes. $40.00 for Chinese servants and $60.00
for Russian watchmen in the Y.M.C.A. Building.
The letter concluded with an apology for the trouble
he was causing, and asked Mr. Hines to accept his
(deceased's) seal as a gift.
Mr. Kosloff, 61 Nanking Road, could not be located on
6-3-38. Deceased's office boy, Hung Ting Waung was
located in his home at No. 26, Lane 180 Seymour Road,
but he was unable to supply any useful information.
The body of deceased was removed by S.P.B. ambulance
to the General Hospital, where the following certificate
was issued:-
"This is to certify that I have examined a male
Russian and found that he was dead on arrival
at the hospital.
(Signed) G. Chambers,
Resident Medical Supt.".
Dr. Chambers gave it as his opinion that death had
occurred about five hours previous to his receiving the
body, which would place the time before 5.30a.m. on
6-3-38.

（签名）G. Chambers，
住院医务主管。”
Chambers 医生认为，死亡时间大约在他接收遗体前五小时，即1938年3月6日凌晨5点30分之前。

page_data.en:
Popular Soviet
Citizen Here
Is Found Dead

A. I. Scherbakoff Shot
Through Head; Left
Suicide Notes

Believed to have shot himself
through the head with an automa-
tic revolver. Alexander I. Scherba-
koff, 47, Soviet Russian, yesterday
morning was found dead in his
room at the Foreign Y.M.C.A., 150
Bubbling Well Road, shortly after
10 o'clock.
An ambulance rushed to the
scene immediately after the discov-
ery which caused an uproar in the
public building, brought the man to
the General Hospital dead. Scher-
bakoff was not a member of any
volunteer body, and the weapon
with which he is thought to have
ended his life was a private revol-
ver. The bullet entered the head,
passing through the brain and
causing instantaneous death.

Body At Morgue

The body is now at the Kiao-
chow Road mortuary, awaiting an
inquest to be held this morning.
The deceased left several letters
to close friends indicating suicide.
These letters were in the hands of
the S. M. Police, unopened, last
night, and their contents will be
divulged at this morning's inquest.
Scherbakoff has been in Shang-
hai for some time, and for more
than two years has been residing
in the Foreign Y.M.C.A. He was
the proprietor of a firm bearing his
name with offices in the Hardoon
Building, 233 Nanking Road, deal-
ing in woolen piece goods. It has
been ascertained that he has no
relatives in Shanghai, his nearest
kin at present residing in Moscow.
While the reason for his alleged
suicide is expected to be fully ex-
plained in the letters he has left
behind for friends, it was not
known up to a late hour last night
what prompted the shooting. Ac-
quaintances discredited reports of
financial stress, and it has been
ascertained that during his two-
year residence at the Foreign "Y."
he was never once behind in his
rent.
During his stay in Shanghai, the
deceased has developed many
friendships both in and outside the
Foreign Y.M.C.A. He was consi-
dered one of the exemplary and
most popular residents of the
institution.
page_data.zh:
在此的苏联公民
被发现死亡

A. I. 谢尔巴科夫头部中枪；
留下自杀遗书

据信是用自动左轮手枪向头部开枪自杀。亚历山大·I·谢尔巴科夫（Alexander I. Scherbakoff），47岁，苏俄籍，于昨日上午10点后不久，被发现死于静安寺路150号外侨青年会（Foreign Y.M.C.A.）的房间内。
发现后立即有救护车赶赴现场，这一事件在该公共建筑内引起骚动，但将该男子送至广慈医院（General Hospital）时已死亡。谢尔巴科夫并非任何志愿团体的成员，据信其用来结束生命的武器是一支私人左轮手枪。子弹射入头部，穿过大脑，导致瞬间死亡。

尸体在殓房

尸体现位于胶州路殓房，等待今早举行的死因研讯。死者给几位密友留下了表明自杀意图的信件。这些信件昨晚仍在上海公共租界工部局警务处手中，尚未拆封，其内容将在今天上午的死因研讯中公开。
谢尔巴科夫在上海已有一段时间，并在外侨青年会居住了两年多。他是哈同大楼（Hardoon Building，南京路233号）一家以其名字命名的公司的业主，经营毛呢匹头生意。经查实，他在上海没有亲属，其最近的亲属目前居住在莫斯科。
虽然预计他留给朋友的信件将充分解释其所谓自杀的原因，但直到昨晚很晚的时候，人们仍不知道是什么促使他开枪。熟人们否认了关于他面临经济压力的报道，并且已经查明，在他在外侨“青年会”居住的两年期间，他的房租从未拖欠过一次。
在上海逗留期间，死者在外侨青年会内外结交了许多朋友。他被视为该机构中最模范、最受欢迎的住户之一。

page_data.en:
RUSSIAN FOUND DEAD
AT FOREIGN "Y"

Shot Through Head With
Small Pistol; Found
Dead By Room Boy

Mr. A. I. Scherbakoff, 48-year-old
citizen of the U.S.S.R., was found
dead in his room on the fifth floor
of the Foreign Y.M.C.A. on Bubbling
Well Road by the room boy yester-
day morning. Upon the resident
manager being called, the latter
summoned an ambulance, which im-
mediately conveyed the Russian to
the General Hospital, but he was
found to be beyond medical aid upon
arrival. There was a bullet wound
in his head.

Detectives of the Sinza Road
Police Station were yesterday in-
vestigating circumstances and rea-
sons leading to the elderly Russian's
tragic death. Several letters were
left in his room by the deceased.
These will be opened at the inquest
to be held this morning at the Kiao-
chow Road Mortuary.

The man was last seen alive at
about nine o'clock on Saturday
night, and he must have died be-
tween that hour and ten o'clock
yesterday morning, when the boy
went into his room and found him
lying on his bed.

The deceased was a piece-goods
merchant and had resided for about
a year at the Foreign Y.M.C.A. He
had no relatives in Shanghai.
page_data.zh:
俄国人在外侨“青年会”
被发现死亡

头部被小手枪击中；
由侍者发现死亡

A. I. 谢尔巴科夫先生，48岁，苏联公民，于昨日上午被侍者在静安寺路外侨青年会五楼的房间内发现死亡。在住店经理被叫来后，后者召唤了一辆救护车，立即将该俄国人送往广慈医院，但到达时已发现无法救治。他头部有枪伤。
新闸路捕房的侦探昨日正在调查导致这位年迈俄国人悲剧死亡的情况和原因。死者在房间内留下了几封信。这些信件将在今天上午于胶州路殓房举行的死因研讯中开启。
此人最后一次被人看到活着是在周六晚上九点左右，他必定是在那个时间到昨日上午十点之间死亡的，当时侍者进入他的房间，发现他躺在床上。
死者是一名匹头商人，在外侨青年会居住了约一年。他在上海没有亲属。

page_data.en:
D14#2

Inquest Finds
Soviet Citizen
Took Own Life

Scherbakoff Letters
State Desire To Be
Cremated

A verdict of suicide was returned
at the inquest of Alexander I.
Scherbakoff, 47-year-old Soviet
citizen who shot himself through
the head with an automatic
revolver in his room at the Foreign
Y.M.C.A., 150 Bubbling Well Road,
Sunday morning. The inquest was
held at the Kiaochow Road mortu-
ary yesterday morning, when letters
written by the deceased to friends
were opened.
The letters showed that in
taking his own life, the late Mr.
Scherbakoff did not act upon im-
pulse, as its contents reveal pre-
meditation. In them, he expressed
a desire to be cremated, and left
instructions for the disposal of his
property in Shanghai.
Mr. Scherukoff was found dead
in his room by the boy at 9:50
o'clock Sunday morning, shot
through the head. A fired revolver
lay by his side. His death, believed
to have occurred not more than two
hours before, is said to have been
instantaneous, the bullet passing
through the brain.
Scherbakoff has been a resident
of Shanghai for several years, put-
ting up at the Foreign Y.M.C.A. for
more than two years during which
he was looked upon as one of the
exemplary and most popular re-
sidents of the institution. He was
the proprietor of a woollen piece
goods firm bearing his name with
offices in the Hardoon Building, 233
Nanking Road. He has no relatives
in Shanghai, his nearest kin resid-
ing in Moscow.
In his letters, the deceased gave
no concrete reason for his drastic
action, but inferred that he was
tired of life in general. If the de-
ceased had any financial worries,
these are not known to his close
friends.

D14#2

死因研讯认定
苏联公民
自杀身亡

谢尔巴科夫信件
表示希望火化

周日早晨，47岁的苏联公民亚历山大·I·谢尔巴科夫在静安寺路150号外侨青年会的房间内用自动左轮手枪向头部开枪自杀，死因研讯对此作出了自杀的裁决。死因研讯于昨日上午在胶州路殓房举行，期间开启了死者写给朋友的信件。
信件显示，已故的谢尔巴科夫先生在自杀时并非一时冲动，因为信件内容揭示了预谋。他在信中表达了火化的愿望，并留下了处置其在上海财产的指示。
周日上午9点50分，侍者在谢尔巴科夫先生的房间内发现他头部中枪死亡。一把发射过的左轮手枪躺在他身边。据信他的死亡发生在不超过两小时前，据说子弹穿过大脑，导致瞬间死亡。
谢尔巴科夫在上海居住已有数年，在外侨青年会住宿超过两年，在此期间，他被视为该机构中最模范、最受欢迎的住户之一。他是哈同大楼（南京路233号）一家以其名字命名的毛呢匹头公司的业主。他在上海没有亲属，其最近的亲属居住在莫斯科。
在他的信件中，死者并未给出其激烈行动的具体原因，但暗示他对一般的生活感到厌倦。如果死者有任何财务担忧，他的密友并不知情。
